scope: Proposition 9.3 (Cycle costs under a change of law) of the manuscript “Routing densities and representation contraction for Thorp sweeps” (preprints/Routing-densities-and-representation-contraction-for-Thorp-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4e5fbcff0dec65fd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 60. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For any fixed input tuple of k distinct positions and any law Q on the raw switches, the actual tracked cycle counts satisfy EQ X j C∗ j ≤ CΛn(k) + CD(Q∥fair), (92) with an absolute constant C.
